M3.reason: The brief names a crowbar and its tips, so the hooked claw at the head is the named part, and it is absent. sides.png and first-person.png show no claw, hook or bent head; the only feature is a diagonal bevel across the plate. A part the brief names is missing, so M3 is 0.

This is the line-up's result, not a visual judgement by this judge.

Its front cannot be told, though, since the head with its claw is absent, so it is not clear which end is the front or whether it is placed as the original is.
